title: rhine water level drops around record lows costs industry rise 2026 07 31
text:
HAMBURG, July 30 (Reuters) - Water levels on the Rhine river in Germany fell to near record lows on Friday as a heatwave and prolonged dry weather gripped ​the region, the country's navigation agency said, though cargo vessels ‌continued to operate.
